Hi Alice — great speaking earlier this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

1) Recap
- FinHealth is evaluating a private/VPC-hosted inference deployment for customer PII processing and needs documentation around SOC 2, GDPR data handling, and HIPAA eligibility.
- Key constraints: EU data residency for some pipelines, need for a signed BAA for PHI flows, and procurement timeline targeting end of April.

2) Where we stand (short answers)
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II controls for our hosted environments; we also provide enterprise artifacts for Dedicated/Private deployments. I've attached a short SOC 2 overview for your security team.
- GDPR: We support data residency and can recommend deployment patterns (regional routing + private control plane) to keep EU data in-region.
- HIPAA/BAA: We offer BAAs for Dedicated and Private deployments (not for our public multi-tenant hosted API). For PHI, we recommend private deployment with customer-managed keys.
- Private/VPC/on-prem: We support private VPC deployments (VPC peering or private link), dedicated capacity, and an on-prem/air-gapped option for regulated customers. Attached is a high-level VPC deployment diagram and our security questionnaire template to speed the SSQ back-and-forth.

3) Documents attached (stubs)
- Redwood_SOC2_overview.pdf (high-level controls and timeline)
- redwood_vpc_deployment_diagram.png (topology options: VPC peering, PrivateLink, on-prem air-gapped)
- security_questionnaire_template.xlsx (to capture standard answers)

4) Proposed next steps
- Monica (cc'd) can start filling your SSQ. Could you share your latest SSQ spreadsheet?
- Let's schedule a 30-minute deep-dive between FinHealth security + our security engineer (Monica) and solutions engineer (Rachel) — proposed times: 2028-03-17 10:00am PT or 2028-03-17 2:00pm PT.

If either of those times work I will send a calendar invite. Thanks again — happy to prioritize any specific items your procurement team needs for the April timeline.

Best,

Marcus / Rachel — starting a draft SSQ response. Notes below and attachments: SSQ_answer_draft.xlsx (stub) with line-by-line answers, and a short notes file with topology options. Summary: 

- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II audit for our hosted environment in 2027 and we maintain continuous monitoring. For Dedicated/Private, many controls map directly but some infrastructure controls differ; we can provide an SOC 2 bridge letter and customer-specific artifacts for Private deployments on request.
- GDPR: We support region-specific deployments. For EU residency, recommended pattern is: customer deploys Dedicated instances in EU region + private control plane or VPC peering to keep inference traffic in-region. We have region routing policies and can provide data processing addenda (DPA).
- HIPAA/BAA: We can provide a BAA for Dedicated/Private customers. For on-prem/air-gapped, customer-managed key material and offline attestations are available; our legal team can share a BAA template.
- Network isolation: Options include VPC peering, AWS PrivateLink, or customer-hosted transit VPCs. For air-gapped, we support an on-prem appliance + manual attestation process.

- Populate SSQ_answer_draft.xlsx and send to FinHealth by EOD tomorrow.
- Share compliance artifacts via secure drive link (see related links).
- Confirm availability for the security deep-dive (I can do 03/17 10:00am PT).
